title: Te Pononga o te Whakaaro Nui
intro: I roto i te whānuitanga o ngā kōrero a te Quran, e tū ana tētahi tangata ngaro, he pononga nā Allah kua whakanuia ki te mātauranga atua me te aroha noa. I tūtaki tēnei tangata ngaro ki tētahi o ngā poropiti nui rawa atu, ā, i arahina atu ki tētahi haerenga kī tonu i ngā mahi whakapoauau i wero i ngā rohe o te māramatanga tangata. Ahakoa te āhua hē o ia mahi, i hunaia ngā akoranga hohonu mō te aituā, te manawanui, me te whakaaro nui ngaro i muri i te whakataunga atua. Ko wai tēnei tangata pōuri, ā, he aha ngā pono i huraina e rātou?
clues: He pononga ahau nā Allah, i whiriwhiria mō te mātauranga motuhake me te aroha noa.
I whai tetahi poropiti nui ki te ako i ahau, ā, i whakaae ahau i raro i ngā tikanga tino pakari.
I roto i tā māua hui, e toru ngā mahi i mahia e au, ā, i te whakaaro o taku hoa, he mahi hē tēnei.
I pakaru i ahau te poti o te hunga rawakore, engari he mahi tohu huna tēnā.
I tangohia e au te ora o tētahi tamaiti, ahakoa te āhua nanakia, i meatia kia kore ai e pouri ōna mātua.
I hanga anō e au tētahi taiepa i tētahi tāone i whakakahore i a mātou ki te manaaki, e huraina ana tētahi taonga i raro iho.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
